name: v3 7% line, real money, 7% of the full Kalshi balance (compounding), $150 realized-loss limit
status: FROZEN. Do not edit. Any change needs a new file and a new hash pinned in server/live/kalshi-pilot.js PILOT_SHA256 and test/kalshi-pilot.test.js.
source: Bryan, 2026-11-01: 'Ok time to set up live trading with Kalshi using the strategies v1 - v3'; pilot bankroll $100 total; go live with v3 only; 'I want it to be the 7% version'. 2026-11-01 (p2): $150 in the MAIN Kalshi account, use the full amount, no subaccount; reuse the desk's existing Kalshi key. Arming needs a separate message from Bryan and a typed phrase on the desk machine. 2026-11-01 (p3): 'I don't want it to only go off of 150. I wanted to go off of the full amount that's in the account... like it compounds.' The $150 bankroll cap is removed; $150 becomes a realized-loss limit.
money: integer cents for limits; Kalshi amounts parsed exactly to integer micro-dollars
bankrollRule: bankroll = the FULL live Kalshi account balance + the pilot's own open cost (already out of cash), re-read before each decision (throttled refresh in shadow, a fresh read before every armed slice); no cap, so size compounds with wins and deposits. No balance read: shadow skips the decision, armed halts.
account: main account (no subaccount): balance checks compare only the pilot's own fills and fees, never the absolute balance; other positions and orders are never managed or cancelled (sizing uses the full cash balance)
openRiskRule: total open risk (the pilot's own open cost + fees) <= the live bankroll
dailyStopNote: OFF so live stays comparable with paper v3 (the paper arms have no daily stop). Code and tests exist; switching on (e.g. 1000 and true) needs a new file and hash.
dailyBudgetSizing: when shrinkToDailyBudget is true and a daily stop is set: before each slice, the worst-case loss (cost + fee if the contract settles NO) of the new contracts plus today's realized loss plus today's open worst-case must stay within the daily stop; size down, or skip if under 1 contract
lossLimit: the only fixed guardrail: permanent HALT when cumulative realized pilot P&L since start (real fills and fees) <= -lossLimitCents; cleared only by a manual reset file data/live/kalshi-pilot/RESET_TOTAL_STOP plus the localhost reset phrase. Checked after each settlement, so one trade at 7% of a large balance can overshoot it.

order.hold: to settlement; the pilot never sells

fees.formula: per order: ceil_to_cent(0.07 * C * P * (1 - P)); real fees always come from Kalshi fill data

armPhraseRule: derived in code from lossLimitCents: 'ARM LIVE $' + dollars + ' LOSS LIMIT' (= 'ARM LIVE $150 LOSS LIMIT')
